::: {.callout-caution}
Using these features result in the presence of a margin column and main column becomes narrower. This affects the whole document.
:::

## Margin table

A table placed in the margin.

```
::: {.column-margin}

| speed | dist |
|-------|------|
| 4     | 2    |
| 4     | 10   |
| 7     | 4    |

:::
```
